spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पयते)
To go, to move.

n. (-यं)
Water.
E.
पा to drink, अच् aff. and युक् augment.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
Low, vile, reprehensible, contemptible.
n. (-य्यं)
1

Measure.
2

Water.
3

Drinking.
4

Practice, profession.
E.
पा to drink, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-यः)
A piece of water.
E.
पयस् water, चय collection.

Water.
2

Milk.
E.
पय to go, असुन् Uṇādi aff.

Water.
2

Milk.
E.
पयस् the same, अच् added.

mfn. (-सः-सी-सं)
Made of or from milk or water.
mn. (-सः-सं)
1 An oblation of milk, rice, and sugar.
2 Turpentine.
n. (-सं)
Milk.
E.
पयस् milk, aff. अण्.

m. (-स्पः)
A cat.
E.
पयस् milk, and प who drinks.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
1 Made from milk, (curds, butter, cheese, &c.)
2 Relating to or connected with milk or water.
f. (-स्या)
1 A shrub, (Asclepias rosea.)
2 A medicinal kind of moon plant.
3 A drug: see क्षीरकाकोली.
4 Curds of two milk whey.
5 Any plant yielding a milky sap, as the Euphorbia, the Asclepias, &c.
E.
पयस् milk, यत् aff.

m. (-लः)
A goat.
E.
पयस्, वलच् aff.

f. (-नी)
1 A river.
2 A milch cow.
3

Night.
4

A she goat.
E.
पयस् water or milk, विनि aff.

m. (-डः)
Hail.
n. (-डं)
An island.
E.
पयस् water, गड a drop.

m. (-नः)
Hail.
E.
पयस् water, चन a lump.

m. (-न्मा)
A cloud.
E.
पयस् water, जन्मन् origin.

m. (-दः)
A cloud.
E.
पयस्, and द what gives.

m. (-रः)
1 A woman's breast.
2 A cloud.
3 The sugarcane.
4 The cocoanut.
5 A sort of rush, (Scirpus kysoor.)
6 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus, &c.) (In Prosody) A scolius.
E.
पयस् milk or water, and धर containing.

m. (-धाः)
1 The ocean.
2 A piece of water.
3 A cloud.
E.
पयस् water, धा to contain, Uṇādi aff. असि.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
पयस्, and धा to have, कि aff.

n. (-कं)
Cuttle fish bone.
E.
पयोधि, and कन् aff.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
पयस्, and निधि a treasure.

m. (-मुक्)
A cloud.
E.
पयस्, and मुच् what lets go.

m. (-रः)
The Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)
E.
पयस् water, रा to get, aff. क.

f. (-शिः)
A piece of water.
E.
पयस्, and राशि a quantity.

n. (-तं)
Living upon milk for a month, which with prayer and residence in a cow house, is an expiation for receiving an unsuitable present; offering of milk to VIṢṆU, and subsisting upon it for twelve days; also for one or for three days as a religious act.
E.
पयस् milk, and व्रत religious observance.

f. (-ष्णी)
A river that rises in the Vindhya mountain.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Fond of or relating to a mixture of milk, &c.
E.
पायस, and ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A foot-soldier, a footman.
E.
पा to cherish, ण्वुल् aff., and युक् and इट् augments.

m. (-युः)
The anus.
E.
पा to preserve, Uṇādi aff. उण् and युक् inserted.
